verdict.rationale: Kimi's own docs list web search as a capability: a general 搜索 (search) feature in the assistant help, a 深度研究 (deep research) product, and 'search the web' in the Kimi Code CLI and editor tools. One hands-on report says Kimi pulled from Wikipedia to answer a question, which suggests answers can be grounded in web sources. Nothing in the pack documents citations linking back to sources, and the help entries are only one-line titles. missing for 10: documented source citations/links in answers, first-party docs detailing how answers are grounded in current web results, independent corroboration of citation quality and freshness

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can get answers grounded in current web results with citations back to the sources

citations.quote: 搜索、记忆、定时任务、技能等通用功能
